period_note: Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention (for Q1, cumulative equals the discrete first-quarter figure) established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 31 March 2023'. Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (1st_quarter_2023.pdf) is a scanned/OCR document whose embedded pdftotext text layer was badly corrupted; all figures below were sourced via direct visual inspection of 350dpi page renders of the standalone Balance Sheet (source page 7) and Profit and Loss Account (source page 9), both independently verified fully internally consistent (balance sheet ties to the taka: Total Liabilities 278,204,018,502 + Total Shareholders' Equity 23,569,012,608 = Total Assets 301,773,031,110; Profit before tax 1,290,504,358 - Provision for tax 553,887,124 = Net Profit after tax 736,617,234). PRESENTATION CHANGE this quarter: 'Interest on perpetual bonds' (BDT 124.68mn) is now shown as a post-tax 'Appropriation' (alongside Statutory reserve) rather than a pre-EPS deduction as in FY2022 filings; the reported EPS of 0.70 is calculated on the FULL Net Profit after tax (736,617,234 / 1,057,545,805 ordinary shares), NOT net of the perpetual bond interest -- a different EPS basis than the 2022_Q1/Q2/Q3 filings used (which netted the perpetual bond interest out before computing EPS). profit_after_tax_cumulative below is the full PAT either way, so this does not affect that figure's comparability, only the EPS basis. Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2022' column (Total Assets BDT 301,807.57mn, Total Liabilities BDT 278,774.96mn, Total Equity BDT 23,032.61mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2022_Q4.json exactly -- no discrepancy.

source.source_page_lines: Source PDF page 7 (Balance Sheet, 'As at 31 March 2023') and page 9 (Profit and Loss Account, 'For the period ended 31 March 2023'). pdftotext -layout text layer was badly corrupted (systematic OCR digit-substitution errors); figures verified via direct visual inspection of 350dpi page renders instead of the text layer.
